Title: Login succeeds with valid admin account
Preconditions: Application is running locally and seeded admin account exists.
Test Data: Email=admin@osms.local; Password=Admin@12345
Steps: 1 Open /Admin/Auth/Login; 2 Enter admin email; 3 Enter valid password; 4 Click Sign in.
Expected Result: User is redirected to the admin area dashboard; authenticated session is established; no validation error is shown.
Actual Result: Valid admin login reached the admin dashboard successfully in the focused Selenium rerun.

Title: Login rejects invalid password for admin account
Preconditions: Application is running locally and login page is reachable.
Test Data: Email=admin@osms.local; Password=WrongAdmin@12345
Steps: 1 Open /Admin/Auth/Login; 2 Enter valid admin email; 3 Enter invalid password; 4 Click Sign in.
Expected Result: User remains on the login page; an invalid login error is displayed; no admin session is created.

Title: Sales account is denied access to Purchases module
Preconditions: Application is running and sales account exists.
Test Data: Email=sales@osms.local; Password=Sales@12345
Steps: 1 Log in as sales user; 2 Navigate directly to /Admin/Purchases.

Actual Result: Direct navigation to /Admin/Purchases with sales@osms.local was rejected and redirected back to the dashboard instead of opening the Purchases module.

Title: Warehouse account is denied access to Invoices module

Title: Create a new admin user with valid group assignment

Steps: 1 Log in as admin; 2 Open /Admin/Admins/Create; 3 Fill all required fields with valid values; 4 Select an active admin group; 5 Submit the form.
Expected Result: System creates the new admin account successfully; success toast appears; the new account is visible in the admin user list.

Title: Current admin cannot deactivate own account
Preconditions: Admin user is logged in and can access the admin user list.
Test Data: Current user=admin@osms.local
Steps: 1 Log in as admin; 2 Open /Admin/Admins; 3 Locate the currently logged in account row; 4 Attempt to disable the same account.
Expected Result: System blocks the action; an error toast is shown; the current account remains active and usable.

Title: Editing Super Admin group is blocked
Preconditions: Admin user is logged in and Super Admin group exists in the database.
Test Data: Group Name=Super Admin
Steps: 1 Log in as admin; 2 Open /Admin/AdminGroups; 3 Locate the Super Admin group; 4 Click Edit or navigate to its edit action.
Expected Result: System blocks editing the Super Admin group; user is returned to the group list with an error toast.

Title: Create invoice successfully for walk-in sale with unpaid status
Preconditions: Sales or admin user is logged in; at least one active product has stock greater than 0.
Test Data: Customer=None; Product=Any active in-stock product; Qty=1; PaidAmount=0
Steps: 1 Log in as sales or admin; 2 Open /Admin/Invoices/Create; 3 Leave customer empty for walk-in sale or choose a valid customer; 4 Select one active in-stock product; 5 Set quantity to 1; 6 Set paid amount to 0; 7 Submit the invoice.
Expected Result: Invoice is created successfully; details page is shown; invoice status is Unpaid; stock is reduced by the sold quantity.
Actual Result: Submitting a valid walk-in invoice returned to the Create page with the toast message Failed to create invoice. Please check data and try again. Server log confirms InvalidOperationException caused by a user-initiated transaction with MySqlRetryingExecutionStrategy in InvoicesController.Create line 145.

Title: Invoice creation is blocked when no product is selected
Preconditions: Sales or admin user is logged in and can access invoice creation page.
Test Data: Customer=Optional valid customer; Item row left without ProductId
Steps: 1 Log in as sales or admin; 2 Open /Admin/Invoices/Create; 3 Keep the default item row without selecting a product; 4 Submit the form.
Expected Result: Invoice is not created; validation error is shown; user stays on the create form.

Title: Invoice creation fails when requested quantity exceeds stock
Preconditions: Sales or admin user is logged in; a product with known low stock is identified from the stock screen.
Test Data: Product=Any active product with low stock; Qty=AvailableStock+1; PaidAmount=0
Steps: 1 Check current stock for a target product from /Admin/Stock; 2 Open /Admin/Invoices/Create; 3 Select the same product; 4 Enter quantity greater than available stock; 5 Submit the invoice.
Expected Result: Invoice is not finalized; system shows a failure message about insufficient stock; no stock corruption occurs.

Title: Recording payment updates invoice from partial to paid
Preconditions: An existing unpaid invoice with positive remaining balance is available.
Test Data: Invoice=Any unpaid invoice; First Payment=less than total; Second Payment=remaining balance
Steps: 1 Open an unpaid invoice details page; 2 Enter a payment amount smaller than the grand total; 3 Submit payment; 4 Verify status becomes PartiallyPaid; 5 Enter the remaining balance; 6 Submit payment again.
Expected Result: Paid amount is updated correctly; invoice status changes first to PartiallyPaid and then to Paid when balance reaches zero.

Title: Cancelling invoice returns stock and marks invoice as cancelled
Preconditions: A non-cancelled invoice with at least one item exists and current stock can be observed before cancellation.
Test Data: Invoice=Any non-cancelled invoice; Product Stock Before=recorded from stock screen
Steps: 1 Record the current stock value for an invoiced product from /Admin/Stock; 2 Open the invoice details page; 3 Click Cancel; 4 Refresh the stock screen for the same product.
Expected Result: Invoice status becomes Cancelled; stock increases by the cancelled quantity; a stock movement entry is recorded.

Title: Reports page handles reversed date range without crashing
Preconditions: Sales or admin user is logged in and has permission to open reports.
Steps: 1 Log in as sales or admin; 2 Open /Admin/Reports?from=2026-04-05&to=2026-03-01.
Expected Result: Reports page loads successfully; the system normalizes the date range or otherwise displays valid report totals instead of failing.

Title: Reports export generates workbook for selected date range

Steps: 1 Log in as sales or admin; 2 Open /Admin/Reports with a valid date range; 3 Click the Export Excel action.
Expected Result: An Excel file is downloaded successfully; workbook contains summary, sales, and purchase sections for the selected range.

Title: Receiving a draft purchase increases stock
Preconditions: A draft purchase exists with known product quantity and the current stock for that product is recorded.
Test Data: Draft Purchase=created earlier; Product Stock Before=recorded value
Steps: 1 Open the draft purchase details page; 2 Click Receive; 3 Open the stock screen for the purchased product; 4 Compare stock before and after receive.
Expected Result: Purchase status becomes Received; product stock increases by the purchase quantity; movement history includes an inbound stock record.

Title: Cancelling a received purchase is blocked
Preconditions: A purchase already in Received status exists.
Test Data: Purchase Status=Received
Steps: 1 Open the details page of a received purchase; 2 Click Cancel.
Expected Result: System blocks cancellation; error toast is shown; purchase status remains Received.

Title: Cancelling a draft purchase succeeds without updating stock
Preconditions: A separate draft purchase exists and has not been received yet.
Test Data: Purchase Status=Draft
Steps: 1 Open the details page of a draft purchase; 2 Click Cancel; 3 Recheck stock for the purchased product.
Expected Result: Purchase status becomes Cancelled; no stock is added because the purchase was never received.

Title: Purchase details page displays created supplier and item summary correctly
Preconditions: A draft purchase created in the current test cycle exists.
Test Data: Purchase=Any newly created draft purchase
Steps: 1 Create a draft purchase or open one created earlier; 2 Review its details page.
Expected Result: Purchase number, supplier, items, quantities, and totals are displayed correctly on the details screen.
Actual Result: The purchase details page showed the generated purchase number, supplier, line item, quantity, and totals correctly for the newly created draft purchase.

Expected Result: Import completes successfully; success toast is shown; imported or updated products appear in product list.

Title: Invoice creation ignores a tampered client-posted unit price and uses the server-side sale price
Preconditions: Sales or admin user is logged in; an active product with stock greater than 0 exists; browser developer tools can edit form values before submit.
Test Data: Customer=walk-in; Product=SP011 or another in-stock product; Qty=1; Tampered UnitPrice=1 or another incorrect value
Steps: 1 Log in as sales or admin; 2 Open /Admin/Invoices/Create; 3 Select an in-stock product and quantity 1; 4 Before submitting, use browser developer tools to change the hidden field Items[0].UnitPrice to an incorrect value; 5 Submit the invoice; 6 Open the created invoice details.
Expected Result: The created invoice uses the server-side product SalePrice from the database, not the tampered client-posted UnitPrice; totals and line values reflect the real server-side price.

Title: Public product details page shows the selected product information correctly

Test Data: Target Product=any active product from listing
Steps: 1 Open /Product; 2 Click an active product card from the listing; 3 Observe the details page header, breadcrumb, category, brand, and price.
Expected Result: The details page opens for the selected product; the product name, category, brand, price, and navigation breadcrumb are displayed correctly.
